title: Structure-sheaf sections on an intersection are a filtered colimit
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. Let $E\subset |X|$ be an intersection of a nonempty set-indexed family of quasi-compact opens. After replacing the family by its finite-intersection refinement, write $E=\bigcap_{i\in I}U_i$ with each $U_i$ quasi-compact open and with $I$ directed by reverse inclusion: for every $i,j$ there is $k$ with $U_k\subseteq U_i\cap U_j$. Give $E$ the subspace topology and the inverse-image structure sheaf $\mathcal O_X|_E$ along the inclusion [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image], and let $\rho_i:\Gamma(U_i,\mathcal O_X|_{U_i})\to\Gamma(E,\mathcal O_X|_E)$ be the canonical restriction maps (the unit of the inverse image along $E\hookrightarrow U_i$). Then: (a) every $s\in\Gamma(E,\mathcal O_X|_E)$ equals $\rho_i(a)$ for some $i\in I$ and some $a\in\Gamma(U_i,\mathcal O_X|_{U_i})$; (b) if $a,a'\in\Gamma(U_i,\mathcal O_X|_{U_i})$ satisfy $\rho_i(a)=\rho_i(a')$, then $a|_{U_k}=a'|_{U_k}$ for some $k\in I$ with $U_k\subseteq U_i$. Equivalently, the canonical map $$\varinjlim_{i\in I}\Gamma(U_i,\mathcal O_X|_{U_i})\longrightarrow\Gamma(E,\mathcal O_X|_E)$$ induced by the $\rho_i$ is an isomorphism, the filtered colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] being taken in sets, in abelian groups or in commutative rings. The identification is natural for isomorphisms of schemes carrying the indicated opens and intersections to one another.

proof.text: Use the unit-characterized set inverse-image composition isomorphisms to transfer the fixed-stage continuity result to inverse images of the ambient underlying-set structure sheaf. Use the existing spectral-continuity module comparison-map API for unit compatibility and associativity; all further restriction squares follow from adjunction uniqueness. The open-embedding clause of subspace unit coherence proves that the unit to the whole open subspace is bijective. Its naturality identifies the transition with ordinary restriction. This yields representatives and eventual equality on the original opens, retaining repeated labels.

proof.text: Naturality of the inverse-image unit makes these ring maps a cocone on all distinct original opens. Reverse inclusion is directed by the assumed family refinement. Apply directed-ring cocone recognition, and transport its ring, additive-group, and set colimits through the equivalence from the order dual to the opposite inclusion category.

proof.text: For the final transport, the scheme structure-sheaf map followed by the unit on the source intersection is a map to the composite pushforward. Its adjoint along the target intersection inclusion is the required transport. The adjunction gives its all-open unit equation and uniqueness. Naturality at the inclusion of the top open gives the stated restriction squares. This argument works for every scheme map carrying the opens by inverse image, hence for the stated isomorphism; empty intersections cause no exception.
